subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw accept `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in web_search provider that sends search queries to Firecrawl without a key, despite Firecrawl’s OpenAPI still declaring bearer auth for `/search`?
rationale: The code path is narrow and live no-auth search works now, but publishing a no-key hosted search provider is a privacy, support, and upstream-contract decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Accept opt-in keyless Firecrawl search
options.body: Approve the hosted no-key search boundary, then require a clean rebase plus final focused Firecrawl/provider validation before merge.

options.title: Split search options only
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that expands the credentialed `firecrawl_search` tool options while leaving web_search on the existing keyed provider.

options.title: Decline the provider surface
options.body: Close or pause the keyless provider until Firecrawl documents the no-auth search contract more clearly or a maintainer sponsors the hosted-search policy.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in keyless Firecrawl search
recommendation.body: Approve the hosted no-key search boundary, then require a clean rebase plus final focused Firecrawl/provider validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Firecrawl keyless work and key-free web-search policy review make this the strongest available routing signal for the boundary decision.
